blocks.title: Therapeutic window
blocks.text: Therapeutic window plasma (khoon ka liquid hissa) mein dawa ki concentrations (fi volume miqdar) ki woh range (had) hai jis mein dawa faida deti hai aur harmful side effects (nuqsan wale faltu asar) nahi hote.
Yeh dawa ka “sweet spot” (sab se behtar jagah) hai: miqdar na itni kam ke dawa asar hi na kare, aur na itni zyada ke khatarnak ho jaye.

blocks.title: Minimum effective concentration (MEC)
blocks.text: MEC dawa ki woh sab se kam dose hai jis se neeche dawa koi clinical effect (ilaaj wala asar) nahi deti.

blocks.title: Minimum toxic concentration (MTC)
blocks.text: MTC dawa ki woh sab se kam dose hai jis par dawa adverse effects (bure asar) ya “poisoning” (zehr) dena shuru karti hai.

blocks.title: Duration of action
blocks.text: Duration of action woh waqt hai jitni der dawa ki concentration apni therapeutic window ke andar rehti hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: drug level in plasma (oopar) aur time (daen). Banafshi curve tezi se barhti, MEC (hari dashed) aur MTC (surkh dashed) ke darmiyan hari therapeutic window patti mein choti tak jati, phir dheere dheere MEC se neeche girti hai. MEC ko do baar kaatne wale points ke darmiyan doharay teer par 'duration of action'.
blocks.caption: Aik dose ke baad plasma mein dawa ka level: MEC, MTC aur duration of action (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dawa lene ke baad khoon mein us ki miqdar barhti hai, sab se oopar pohanchti hai, phir jism use bahar nikalta rehta hai aur miqdar ghatti hai. Jab tak miqdar MEC se oopar aur MTC se neeche (hari patti mein) rahe, dawa faida deti hai aur nuqsan nahi karti; yahi duration of action hai. MTC se oopar miqdar zehreeli hai aur MEC se neeche dawa be-asar hai.

Wide (chauri) therapeutic window ka matlab hai dawa ki safety limits achhi hain, kyunke kaam karne wali dose aur nuqsan dene wali dose mein bara faasla hai. Is se dose kam ya zyada karne ki flexibility (gunjaish) milti hai. Narrow (tang) therapeutic window ka matlab hai dawa kam mehfooz hai, kyunke faida dene wali dose zehreeli dose ke bohat qareeb hai. Aisi dawaiyan prescribe karte (likhte) waqt doctors ko bohat ehtiyat karni parti hai, aur aksar mareez ka blood test karna parta hai taake dawa ki miqdar sahi tang had ke andar rahe.

Aik saath kai dawaiyan lena, genetic factors (khandani asraat), obesity (motapa), umar ya aam sehat bhi dawa ki therapeutic window badal sakte hain. Yeh sab factors (wajuhaat) dawa ke metabolism (jism mein dawa ka tootna aur istemal) aur efficacy (asar karne ki salahiyat) ko control karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke duration of action se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh waqt jitni der khoon mein dawa ki concentration us ki therapeutic window, yani MEC aur MTC ke darmiyan, rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: Narrow therapeutic window wali dawa kam mehfooz kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke us ki faida dene wali dose zehreeli dose ke bohat qareeb hoti hai; thori si zyada miqdar bhi nuqsan de sakti hai, is liye blood test se nigrani karni parti hai.

items: Therapeutic window: plasma mein dawa ki woh had jo faida de aur nuqsan na kare.
MEC se neeche dawa be-asar; MTC se oopar zehreeli.
Wide window: zyada mehfooz; narrow window: blood test se nigrani zaroori.
Kai dawaiyan, genes, obesity, umar aur sehat window badal sakte hain.
